$comment: Curated permanent collections — deliberately NOT scraped.
A permanent collection is the most valuable content in the app: always
accurate, never expires, and no broken selector can take it away. Listing
sites do not advertise it because it is not news, so crawling will never
find it. Written once by hand, it also gives the app a content floor for
`venue` must match a Venue name in the database (case-insensitive). Run
`npm run db:seed-permanent` after editing. The script is idempotent and
matches on venue + title, so correcting text here updates the row rather
Descriptions are intentionally short and factual. Anything promotional
reads as filler next to scraped listings.

collections.title: Pinacoteca di Brera — permanent collection
collections.description: Thirty-eight rooms of Italian painting from the 13th to the 20th century, including Raphael's Marriage of the Virgin, Mantegna's Lamentation of Christ and Piero della Francesca's Montefeltro Altarpiece.

collections.title: Museo del Novecento — permanent collection
collections.description: Twentieth-century Italian art across four floors, from Futurism and Boccioni through Arte Povera, arranged chronologically in the Palazzo dell'Arengario overlooking the Duomo.

collections.title: Galleria d'Arte Moderna — permanent collection
collections.description: Nineteenth-century Lombard painting and sculpture in the neoclassical Villa Reale, including works by Canova, Hayez and Medardo Rosso.

collections.title: Museo Poldi Pezzoli — house museum collection
collections.description: A 19th-century collector's house preserved intact: Renaissance painting, arms and armour, clocks, glass and textiles, including Piero del Pollaiolo's Portrait of a Young Woman.

collections.title: Museo Bagatti Valsecchi — house museum collection
collections.description: A Renaissance-revival residence assembled by two brothers in the 1880s, with its 15th- and 16th-century furnishings, ceramics and paintings still in domestic arrangement.

collections.title: Castello Sforzesco museums — permanent collections
collections.description: Several museums inside the Sforza castle, including the Museum of Ancient Art with Michelangelo's unfinished Rondanini Pietà, the Pinacoteca, and collections of furniture, musical instruments and applied arts.

collections.title: MUDEC — permanent collection
collections.description: Milan's municipal collection of non-European art and objects, roughly two hundred works tracing how the city acquired and interpreted other cultures.

collections.title: Museo del Design Italiano
collections.description: A permanent survey of Italian design from 1946 onwards, several hundred objects arranged chronologically in the Palazzo dell'Arte.

collections.title: Compasso d'Oro collection
collections.description: The complete archive of the Compasso d'Oro award — the objects that defined Italian industrial design since 1954, shown alongside the drawings and prototypes behind them.

collections.title: Fondazione Prada — permanent installations
collections.description: Long-term works within the former distillery, including Robert Gober's and Louise Bourgeois's rooms in the Haunted House and Thomas Demand's Processo Grottesco.

collections.title: The Seven Heavenly Palaces
collections.description: Anselm Kiefer's seven concrete towers, installed permanently in the former industrial hall since 2004, with five large paintings added in 2015.

collections.title: Museo Diocesano — permanent collection
collections.description: Religious art from the Ambrosian diocese, from early Christian fragments to 18th-century painting, in the cloisters of Sant'Eustorgio.

collections.title: Leonardo da Vinci galleries
collections.description: Italy's largest science and technology museum, including the Leonardo gallery of models built from his codices, plus transport, energy and communications collections.

collections.title: Villa Necchi Campiglio
collections.description: A 1930s rationalist villa by Piero Portaluppi kept as its owners left it, with the Claudia Gian Ferrari and Alighiero de' Micheli collections of 20th-century painting and 18th-century decorative arts.

collections.title: Jesi and Vitali collections
collections.description: The modern wing of the Grande Brera, holding the Jesi and Vitali bequests of 20th-century Italian art — Modigliani, Morandi, Boccioni — alongside spaces by Stirling.
